FILES: rich/console.py:2040-2066
CAUSE: `Console._check_buffer` calls `self.file.write()` without catching `BrokenPipeError`, which happens when outputting to a closed pipe (e.g., `rich ... | head`).
FIX: Wrap the write operations in `Console._check_buffer` (both the batched and non-batched paths) in a try-except block that catches `BrokenPipeError` and ignores it (or handles it silently), preventing the application from crashing.
REPRO: fails on original
TESTS: none (adding a new test case is recommended)
